# openmetadata_persona (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata persona by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_persona" "data_steward" {
  fully_qualified_name = "DataSteward"
}

output "data_steward_users" {
  value = data.openmetadata_persona.data_steward.users
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Persona fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Persona UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default persona for the organisation.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Persona name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `users` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the assigned users.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
